Passdroid++ is an open source application that lets you store your passwords in a secure way on your Android device. The passwords are encrypted with AES-256 and a key derived from the master password, \ so they cannot be read without it.
\ https://github.com/jurakovic/passdroid
\ Passdroid++ is based on Passdroid by Magnus Eriksson (http://passdroid.kodholken.com/).

Use your fingerprint instead of the master password to log in.
Not available on this device. It requires Android 9 or later and an enrolled fingerprint.
Fingerprint unlock could not be turned on.
Fingerprint unlock can be turned on after the password database has been upgraded. Log out and log in again with your master password.
Log out when the screen turns off
Log out right away when the screen is turned off, regardless of the logout delay.
Fingerprint unlock failed. Log in with your master password.
Fingerprint unlock was turned off because the fingerprints on this device have changed. Log in with your master password and turn it on again in Settings.
Fingerprint unlock has been turned off. You can turn it on again in Settings.
Before continuing you need to choose a master password \ that will protect the information that is stored on the device. If this password is forgotten \ the passwords stored are not recoverable.
Enter the password you want to use:
"The passwords you entered did not match. Please try again."
The master password must have at least %d \ characters. A few random words are easy to remember and hard to guess.

Your master password has fewer than %d \ characters. Someone with a copy of your passwords, such as an export, could guess it. A \ longer password made of a few random words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
Press the menu button and choose Add Password to create new password entries.
Database successfully exported to %s. Note that the passwords are NOT ENCRYPTED.

\ This will export the password database to a file of your choice. \ In combination with the import function this can be used to move the \ password database to another device or as a way to back up your data. \ The settings are exported as well, except fingerprint unlock. \ If you export the file unencrypted make sure it is \ removed from the phone as quickly as possible since other applications will \ be able to read it.

\ This will import a database of passwords that has been exported from Passdroid++ or Passdroid. \ The import will remove any existing passwords on this device. \ Settings in the file replace the current settings.
The file could not be decrypted using the current master password. Please enter the master password that was in use when you exported the password database.
The settings were imported as well.
Show the 2FA secret as a QR code
Scan this QR code with the authenticator app you \ would like to transfer this entry to
No entries have a 2FA secret yet. Add the 2FA secret of an entry when you edit it, and its code is shown here.
Point the camera at the 2FA QR code
No QR code was found in the image.
This QR code does not contain a 2FA secret.
This QR code is an export from an authenticator app, which is not supported. Use the QR code from the 2FA setup page of the service instead.
No application available for choosing images.
Passdroid++ needs the camera to scan QR codes. You can allow it in the app settings, or read the QR code from an image instead.
The camera could not be started.
